Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job team-skull (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR ~/.claude-team-skull), claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers.

Tier: SAFETY. The PR changes stock simulation (the marching-tetrahedra mesh of the stock field). It does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, or a recorded program. No golden moved.

## What looks good

- The snap is now one value for each sample (`on_surface`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/iso.rs:221`). Each tetrahedron that shares a sample reads the same sign and the same corner. This closes the class of the defect, not only the one case.
- No crossed edge can have two collinear distinct corners on one lattice edge. A corner is either a snapped sample or an interior point of an edge with one inside end (d < 0, so not zero).
- A crossing at a zero sample returns `pa` / `pb` bit for bit. Two crossings that land on the same sample make a facet with two equal corners. `push` drops it, and its two edges cancel, so the mesh stays paired.
- `-0.0` and values under the threshold all read `+0.0`, which is outside. This is the same side as before for `-0.0`.
- The surface moves by at most `NODE_SNAP * step` (0.25 nm at 0.25 mm). The mesh is display and export only ("nothing reads it back as material", `iso.rs:13`).
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. `iso.rs` is 386 lines.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/4180-snap-per-sample.md` gives what was chosen, why, what was dropped, and the cost to change. It does not edit the #4107 file.
- Commits are conventional. The fix commit ends with `Fixes #4180`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #4180`.

## Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main `e6849c5ae`)

The PR head is on `e6849c5ae`, so the trial merge was "Already up to date". HEAD = `4d24dd119`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 4 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 1.6 min.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| sim build (--no-run) | ok |
| sim suites: lib | ok, 280 passed |
| sim suites: stock_dual | ok, 7 passed |
| app suites: stock_export | ok, 2 passed |

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Light lane: not run again here. `cargo xtask gate light --dry-run` plans only motion and pocket twins (`motion light: lib`, `adaptive_troch_*`, `app light: pocket_pass_start`). None of them reaches `sim::stock_sim::iso`. The author's run on this head is green (6 steps, 0 failed, 39.3 min, PR body).

Heavy lanes: not run. The PR is `P3`, so no targeted heavy step is necessary (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review").

Extra suites run: none were necessary. The diff changes no `testdata/`, no fixture or golden directory, and no import code. It changes no post, operation, motion or catalog file, so the example catalog suites do not apply.

## Mutations (each in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/iso.rs`, then restored)

`cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib stock_sim::iso` for each:

1. `marching` reads the raw sample (no `on_surface`): RED. `a_floor_on_the_lattice_reading_both_signs_stays_closed` fails, `open_edges` left 515, right 0.
2. Main's behaviour: raw sample, and the per-edge ratio snap back in `cross`: RED. The same test fails, left 45, right 0. This agrees with the PR body.
3. `on_surface` kept, the two `== 0.0` returns in `cross` removed: RED. `a_snapped_corner_is_the_sample_itself` fails ("corner ... beside the sample ...").

On the restored PR head, the 7 tests of `iso.rs` pass.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `iso.rs:232-233`: the comment says "An edge is crossed only from an inside end (d < 0)". The three-inside arm `([b, c, e], [a])` (`iso.rs:260`) calls `cross(a, ..)` with `a` as the outside end. The conclusion "at most one end reads zero" is still correct, because each crossed edge joins one inside end and one outside end. A better text: "A crossed edge joins an inside end (d < 0) and an outside end, so at most one end reads zero."

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
